charts.name: Bar
charts.description: Compare values across discrete categories or rank categories by magnitude.
charts.example: Monthly sales by product: A $120K, B $95K, C $80K.

charts.name: Waterfall Chart
charts.description: Show how sequential positive and negative changes produce a final total.
charts.dataset_required: Ordered step/category + numeric change; optional subtotal/total.
charts.example: Revenue bridge: Opening $500K + Sales $120K - Returns $30K = Closing $570K.

charts.name: Polar Bar
charts.description: Compare magnitudes around a circular/polar axis.

charts.name: Bar Chart Race
charts.description: Show how category rankings change over time through animation.
charts.example: Top 10 countries by population for each year.

charts.name: Range Bar Chart
charts.description: Display a minimum-to-maximum interval for each category.
charts.example: Project duration: Design 5–12 days, Development 10–25 days.

charts.name: Horizontal Waterfall Chart
charts.description: Show sequential increases and decreases in a horizontal layout.
charts.dataset_required: Ordered category + numeric change; optional totals.

charts.name: Circular Bar Chart
charts.description: Compare category magnitudes in a circular layout.
charts.example: Revenue by region arranged around a circle.

charts.name: Stacked Bar Chart
charts.description: Show totals and composition across categories.
charts.example: Quarterly revenue split by Product, Services, Support.

charts.name: 3D Bar Chart
charts.description: Compare values using three-dimensional bars across dimensions.
charts.dataset_required: Category/series + numeric value; optional second category.

charts.name: Progress Bar
charts.description: Show current progress toward a target or maximum.

charts.name: Bar with Line
charts.description: Compare a bar metric with a line metric, often using different scales.
charts.example: Monthly sales bars with conversion-rate line.

charts.name: Error Bar Chart
charts.description: Show a central estimate with uncertainty or variability.
charts.dataset_required: Category + central value + error or low/high bounds.
charts.example: Average response time 220 ms with confidence range.

charts.name: Stacked Horizontal Bar
charts.description: Compare totals and composition with horizontal stacked bars.

charts.name: Horizontal Bar
charts.description: Compare categories when labels are long or horizontal layout improves readability.
charts.example: Top customer issues with long labels.

charts.name: 100% Stacked Bar
charts.description: Compare proportional composition where each category totals 100%.

charts.name: 100% Stacked Horizontal Bar
charts.description: Compare proportional composition horizontally.

charts.name: Pictorial (Vector Icon) Bar
charts.description: Represent quantities using repeated or scaled icons.
charts.example: Devices by type represented with icons.

charts.name: Polar End-Angle Arc Bar
charts.description: Compare magnitudes using radial bars whose end angle represents the value.

charts.name: Line
charts.description: Show trends and changes across an ordered dimension, especially time.
charts.dataset_required: Time/category + numeric value; optional multiple series.

charts.name: Area
charts.description: Show trends while emphasizing magnitude through filled area.
charts.dataset_required: Ordered dimension + numeric value; optional series.
charts.example: Daily website visits across a month.

charts.name: Stepped Line
charts.description: Show values that change in discrete steps rather than continuously.

charts.name: Smooth Line
charts.description: Show an overall continuous trend using a smoothed curve.

charts.name: Polar Line
charts.description: Show cyclical or directional trends around a polar coordinate system.
charts.example: Average wind speed by compass direction.

charts.name: Stacked Area
charts.description: Show how multiple series contribute to a total over an ordered axis.
charts.example: Monthly energy consumption stacked by Lighting, HVAC, Equipment.

charts.name: 3D Line Chart
charts.description: Show trends across three dimensions using connected lines.
charts.dataset_required: X + Y dimension + numeric/Z value; optional series.
charts.example: Temperature trajectory by day and altitude.

charts.name: Stacked Line Chart
charts.description: Show cumulative contributions of multiple series across an ordered axis.

charts.name: Bump Chart (Ranking)
charts.description: Show how category rankings change across time.

charts.name: Confidence Band Line
charts.description: Show a central trend with an uncertainty/confidence range.
charts.dataset_required: Ordered dimension + central value + lower/upper bounds.

charts.name: Function Plot (Math Equation)
charts.description: Plot a mathematical function over a defined input range.
charts.dataset_required: X values or equation + calculated Y values.
charts.example: Plot y = x² for x from -5 to 5.

charts.name: Multi-X Axis Line
charts.description: Compare series that use different X-axis scales or dimensions.
charts.dataset_required: One or more X dimensions + numeric Y values.
charts.example: Compare sales by calendar month with fiscal period.

charts.name: Pie
charts.description: Show category contributions to a meaningful whole.
charts.dataset_required: Category + numeric value that forms a total.

charts.name: Donut
charts.description: Show part-to-whole composition with a center area for a total/KPI.
charts.example: Expense mix with total spend in center.

charts.name: Nightingale Rose
charts.description: Compare category magnitudes using radial sectors with varying radius.

charts.name: Scatter
charts.description: Show relationships, correlation, clustering, and outliers between numerical variables.
charts.dataset_required: Numeric X + numeric Y per observation; optional category.

charts.name: Bubble
charts.description: Show relationships while using bubble size for a third variable.
charts.dataset_required: Numeric X + numeric Y + numeric size; optional category/color.
charts.example: Country GDP vs population, bubble = exports.

charts.name: Effect Scatter
charts.description: Show relationships/effects while emphasizing notable observations.
charts.dataset_required: Numeric X + numeric Y; optional effect size/category/significance.

charts.name: Scatter Matrix
charts.description: Show pairwise relationships between multiple numerical variables.
charts.dataset_required: Multiple numerical columns with one row per observation.
charts.example: Compare Age, Income, Spend, Tenure pairwise.

charts.name: 3D Scatter Plot
charts.description: Show relationships among three numerical variables.
charts.dataset_required: Numeric X + Y + Z per observation; optional category.

charts.name: 3D Arc Map
charts.description: Show geographic routes or connections as elevated 3D arcs.
charts.dataset_required: Origin longitude/latitude + destination longitude/latitude + optional flow value.

charts.name: 3D Grid Map
charts.description: Represent geographic or spatial data on a 3D grid.
charts.dataset_required: Grid X/Y or longitude/latitude + numeric value; optional category.
charts.example: Retail footfall across a mall grid.

charts.name: Screen Grid Map
charts.description: Display aggregated spatial information using a grid/screen-cell representation.
charts.dataset_required: Grid cell coordinates + numeric value; optional category.

charts.name: Heatmap (Geographic)
charts.description: Show geographic or spatial intensity using color.
charts.dataset_required: X/Y coordinates or geographic grid + numeric intensity.
charts.example: Customer service requests across city locations.

charts.name: 3D Scatter Map
charts.description: Plot geographic points in 3D with an additional height, size, or color dimension.
charts.dataset_required: Longitude + latitude + numeric height/value; optional size/category.
charts.example: Store locations with sales revenue as point height.

charts.name: Contour Map
charts.description: Show continuous spatial values using contour lines or filled contour regions.

charts.name: Deck Multi-layer Map
charts.description: Combine multiple geographic layers such as points, lines, polygons, grids, and routes.
charts.dataset_required: Layer-specific geographic points, lines, polygons, grids, and optional metrics.
charts.example: City operations map with multiple overlays.

charts.name: Geographic Region Map
charts.description: Compare values across geographic regions such as countries, states, or districts.
charts.dataset_required: Region name/code + numeric value; optional category.

charts.name: Geo Connection Lines
charts.description: Show connections, routes, or flows between geographic locations.
charts.dataset_required: Source longitude/latitude + target longitude/latitude + optional flow/value.

charts.name: 3D Geographic Globe
charts.description: Display geographic data on a three-dimensional globe.
charts.dataset_required: Longitude/latitude + optional value, region, point, or flow data.

charts.name: 3D Geo Arcs
charts.description: Show flows or connections between geographic locations using 3D arcs.

charts.name: Candlestick Chart
charts.description: Show open, high, low, and close price movement over time.
charts.dataset_required: Time + open + high + low + close; optional volume.

charts.name: Radar
charts.description: Compare multiple quantitative dimensions across one or more profiles.
charts.example: Compare products across Price, Quality, Speed, Reliability, Support.

charts.name: Box Plot
charts.description: Show distribution, quartiles, median, spread, and outliers.
charts.dataset_required: Raw numeric observations by category OR min/Q1/median/Q3/max.
charts.example: Compare delivery times for Standard, Express, Same-Day.

charts.name: Bullet Chart
charts.description: Compare actual value against a target and qualitative performance ranges.
charts.dataset_required: Actual value + target; optional range thresholds.

charts.name: Heatmap
charts.description: Show value intensity across two dimensions using color.
charts.dataset_required: X category/time + Y category + numeric value.
charts.example: Website traffic by weekday and hour.

charts.name: Calendar Heatmap
charts.description: Show daily values across calendar dates using color intensity.

charts.name: Polar Heatmap
charts.description: Show cyclical or directional values in polar coordinates using color.
charts.example: Hourly activity by day-of-week as circular heatmap.

charts.name: Network Graph
charts.description: Show entities and relationships as nodes and links.
charts.dataset_required: Node ID/label + edge source/target; optional weights.

charts.name: Network Diagram
charts.description: Show structured relationships, flows, dependencies, or system architecture.
charts.example: Application architecture: Frontend → API → Service → Database.

charts.name: Treemap (Tree Sheet)
charts.description: Show hierarchical data using nested rectangles sized by value.

charts.name: Partition Map
charts.description: Show hierarchical structure using proportional spatial partitions.
charts.dataset_required: Hierarchical parent/child data + optional numeric value.

charts.name: Tree Chart
charts.description: Show parent-child hierarchy and relationships.

charts.name: Sunburst
charts.description: Explore multi-level hierarchy using concentric rings.
charts.example: Sales hierarchy: Region → Country → Product → SKU.

charts.name: Calendar Heatmap (Calendar Sheet)
charts.description: Track daily values and identify patterns or seasonality across calendar periods.

charts.name: Correlation Matrix
charts.description: Show strength and direction of relationships between numerical variables.
charts.dataset_required: Numerical columns; correlation coefficients may be precomputed.
charts.example: Correlation among Revenue, Orders, AOV, Marketing Spend.

charts.name: Chord Diagram
charts.description: Show many-to-many relationships or flows between entities.

charts.name: Parallel Coordinates
charts.description: Compare many variables across observations in a high-dimensional dataset.
charts.dataset_required: One row per observation + multiple numerical dimensions.
charts.example: Compare cars across MPG, horsepower, weight, acceleration, price.

charts.name: Sankey
charts.description: Show quantities flowing between stages/entities, with link width representing magnitude.
charts.example: Website flow: Landing → Product → Cart → Checkout → Purchase.

charts.name: Funnel
charts.description: Show progressive reduction through sequential stages.
charts.example: Sales funnel: Leads → Qualified → Proposals → Won.

charts.name: Gauge
charts.description: Display a single value against a defined scale or target range.
charts.dataset_required: Single numeric value + min/max; optional thresholds.

charts.name: Theme River
charts.description: Show how multiple categories change in volume over time.

charts.name: Table
charts.description: Display detailed structured records for inspection, sorting, filtering, and comparison.
charts.dataset_required: Rows/records + named columns of relevant types.
charts.example: Order table: Order ID, Customer, Date, Product, Quantity, Revenue.

charts.name: Pivot Table
charts.description: Summarize and aggregate large datasets by dimensions and measures.
charts.dataset_required: Dimension fields + numeric measures + aggregation definition.

charts.name: KPI
charts.description: Display a key performance indicator as a prominent single value.

charts.name: Big Number
charts.description: Highlight an important current metric, often with change/trend context.
charts.dataset_required: Current value + optional previous value or percentage change.

charts.name: Big Number Total
charts.description: Prominently display an aggregate total.

charts.name: 3D Hexagon Map
charts.description: Show spatial/geographic density using hexagonal cells with height or intensity.
charts.dataset_required: Longitude + latitude + numeric value; optional category.
charts.example: Customer density by city using hexagons.

charts.name: Scatter GL (WebGL)
charts.description: Render very large scatter datasets efficiently with WebGL.
charts.dataset_required: Large set of X/Y numeric points; optional category/size.

charts.name: Lines GL (WebGL)
charts.description: Render large numbers of lines efficiently with WebGL.

charts.name: Flow GL Vector Field
charts.description: Visualize directional flow fields at scale.
charts.example: Wind direction and speed across a weather grid.

charts.name: Graph GL (WebGL)
charts.description: Render large network graphs efficiently with WebGL.
charts.dataset_required: Large node list + source/target edge list; optional weights/categories.

charts.name: 3D Surface Plot
charts.description: Show a continuous surface where height represents a third value.
